column1: Maya Cohen and Dan Rosen started a small bakery in Haifa.
Dan Rosen met Maya Cohen at the market every morning.
The bakery of Maya and Danny sold fresh bread and cake.
Danny talked with Lior Katz about the new oven.
Lior Katz and Dan Rosen fixed the oven at night.
Lior Katz taught Noa Peretz how to bake bread.
Noa Peretz and Lior Katz opened a second bakery in the city.
Maya Cohen wrote a menu for the new bakery.
Eli Baron wrote a review of the bakery for the local paper.
Everyone in the city loved the fresh bread and the cake.
Mayu and Dan Rosen painted the sign of the bakery.
Noa Peretz and Lior Katz served bread to a long line of customers.
